description: This is an ADAD permit application from Georgia's Own Credit Union (the Credit Union) for the use of a ringless voicemail system that the Credit Union intends to use to disseminate messages to members. While the Credit Union believes the use of ringless voicemail may not require an ADAD permit, the Credit Union is submitting this application out of an abundance of caution in case the ringless voicemail system, and the Credit Union's use thereof, falls within the scope of OCGA 46-5-23 and GPSC Rule 515-12-1-
